summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K with its unaudited condensed interim financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, along with CEO/CFO certifications, a news release, and a material change report. This is a routine periodic reporting obligation of a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. The filing adds no M&A, tender, restructuring, or activist activity; it is a standard earnings disclosure under Rule 13a-16. No deal terms, board recommendations, or unusual mechanics are present, and the referenced material change report is incorporated into a shelf registration statement, indicating routine disclosure.
